name: 179-bitfield-parent-bytes
title: Fix #179: bit-field parent field selects 6 bytes instead of 2
description: Issue #179: clicking parent bit-field container row (e.g. uint16_t split into 3 bit-fields) selects sum of children storage bytes (6) instead of one storage unit (2). Root cause: structGroupByteCount sums decodedRowByteCount across children for non-array bit-units.
creator: deviousprophet
